FN-KW1FAAA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 148
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/03/2024
House Bill 148 as introduced appropriates $14,816,579 from the Education Trust Fund to
Tuskegee University for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025. In addition, this bill would
require at least $2,000,000 of this appropriation to be expended for the agricultural research and
extension service state match.

House Bill 148 as passed the House of Representatives appropriates $14,816,579 from the
Education Trust Fund to Tuskegee University for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025. In
addition, this bill would require at least $2,000,000 of this appropriation to be expended for the
agricultural research and extension service state match.
